name: Coffee Pub Puppeteer
tagline: Move the pieces of a scene as one.
description: Groups tiles, lights, walls, sounds, drawings, notes and regions so one pin moves and rotates the whole group, like carts, ships and drawbridges. Tokens can ride a group, and triggers can play sounds or run macros.
pitch: Group tiles, lights, walls and sounds into one object like a cart or ship, then move and rotate it with a single pin.

features.title: One-pin groups
features.text: Bundle tiles, lights, walls, sounds, drawings, notes and regions; drag the pin to move the group.

features.title: Rotate around the pin
features.text: Hold Shift and scroll to turn the whole group; carts and boats can face their direction of travel.

features.title: Riders
features.text: Tokens that move onto a group ride with it, can walk on it, and step off.

features.title: Attackable targets
features.text: Give a group an actor so it is a single target with that actor's hit points.

features.title: Triggers
features.text: Play sounds, run macros or change a tile image when a token boards, the group moves, or it takes damage.

features.title: Group library
features.text: Save groups and place independent copies on any scene.

steps: Open a scene and click New Puppeteer Group in the Blacksmith toolbar, then click the map to place the pin.
Select the pieces, open Puppeteer Groups, and click Add Selected (or Capture Area and drag a box).
Drag the pin to move the group; select the pin, hold Shift and scroll to rotate it.
